page.content:
Bird-hipped herbivores — ceratopsians, stegosaurs, ankylosaurs, and duckbills.

How Ornithischia connects

  • Topic: Dinosauria — Ornithischia is the bird-hipped branch of Dinosauria.
  • Topic: Ceratopsia — Ceratopsians are the horned frilled ornithischians.
  • Topic: Stegosauria — Stegosaurs are the plated ornithischians of the Jurassic.
  • Item: Iguanodon — Iguanodon is an early-named ornithopod inside Ornithischia.

What is Ornithischia?

Ornithischia gathers the beaked plant-eaters whose pubis points backward. Triceratops, Stegosaurus, and the hadrosaurs are its familiar faces, not the ancestors of birds.

Key threads lead to Dinosauria, Ceratopsia, Stegosauria and Iguanodon.
